sloka: अवज्ञाताः पुरा तेन वरदाने हि मानवाः ।एवम् पितामहात् तस्मात् वरदानेन गर्वितः ॥१-१६-६॥
transliteration: avajñātāḥ purā tena varadāne hi mānavāḥ ।evam pitāmahāt tasmāt varadānena garvitaḥ ॥1-16-6॥

translations.english: Having obtained the boon from Brahma, Ravana, greed and arrogant went on bringing destruction to the three worlds. He carried away women by violence. O destroyer of foes his death is possible by men only."
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌ ! (आपकी कृपा से रावण) नामक राक्षस, अपने बल से हम सब को बहुत सताता है और हम उसका कळ भी नहीं कर सकते
